remarks: Experience comfortable living in a prime location at 66 Courtland Ave #C4, a charming 575-square-foot, one-bedroom, one-bathroom condominium in the desirable Glenbrook neighborhood of Stamford. This unit provides a cozy and efficient living space, perfect for first-time homebuyers or those looking to downsize. The property features hardwood floors, ample natural light, and a well-appointed kitchen. Residents enjoy the convenience of on-site laundry facilities and assigned parking, while the well-maintained community boasts beautifully landscaped grounds. Ideally situated close to public transportation, shopping centers, and dining options!
